plan.title: Extend Submission Time offered on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert that Extend Submission Time is offered and clickable while bidding is live.
Select the enabled menu action to open its time-extension dialog.
Assert that clicking the action opens the Increase Event Time window.
Cancel the dialog so no submission-time change is confirmed.
Assert that the extension dialog closed without committing a change.
